# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 8 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6/level-7 martial chassis
# baseline to level 8 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not
# contain derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted
# Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-7
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The
# level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist) is carried forward
# unchanged — PF1 also grants monks SEPARATE bonus feats at 2nd and 6th
# level, but this slice deliberately does not add a new choice-slot for
# either (mirroring the Rogue level-8 precedent: no fixture data and no
# recognition code exist for a repeat bonus-feat grant; it stays named but
# unproven, unchanged by this widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no execution of
# what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2/level-6 bonus
# feat grant recognition, no ki-power execution (extra attack, AC bonus, or
# speed bonus), no fall-damage engine, no High Jump, no Wholeness of Body
# execution, and no level-9+ progression. The unarmed strike damage die
# (confirmed to genuinely rise to 1d10 at level 8, verified independently
# against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com's Medium-monk damage progression
# table — the 1d10 band runs levels 8-11), the Flurry of Blows flat attack
# bonus (steps to +6/+6 at level 8 via the same `monk level - 2` formula,
# attack count genuinely rising to 3 — verified independently against both
# primary sources' verbatim Flurry of Blows rule text, "At 8th level, the
# monk can make two additional attacks when he uses flurry of blows, as if
# using Improved Two-Weapon Fighting"), and Slow Fall's own reach magnitude
# genuinely rising to 40 ft. are the pillars this fixture exercises. The
# PF1 Core Rulebook Monk class table's level-8 "Special" column names only
# "Slow fall 40 ft." per both primary sources — checked and specifically
# confirmed NOT Improved Uncanny Dodge (Monk never gains it at any level per
# either source), so no new class-feature record is grounded or fabricated
# at level 8; Wholeness of Body (granted at level 7) stays granted but
# unexecuted, unchanged.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level8
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:8
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:stunning_fist
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
